message: How do I create a new project?
To create a new project, click the 'New Project' button in the dashboard. Give your project a name, select a template, and click 'Create'. Your new project will open automatically.
Where can I find my API keys?
Your API keys are located in Settings > Developer > API Keys. You can create new keys or revoke existing ones. Keep your keys secure and never share them publicly.
Go to your project settings and click the 'Collaborators' tab. Enter the email address of the person you want to invite and select their permission level (View, Edit, or Admin).
